summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/5/6 re-review replaced the scaffold two-row activity artifact with the complete recoverable Tables 1-2 MIC matrix, replaced automated mechanism notes with bounded phenotype/mechanism ontology, preserved prior worker-4 database cautions, and closes the targeted rework tickets as accepted_with_cautions after strict gate rerun.
adjudication_summary: Tables 1-2 provide 72 primary MIC records with peptide, target, raw value/unit, assay conditions, and XML/PDF locators. Mechanism evidence is limited to MIC/TLC-DB phenotype and resazurin assay-interference context; no direct molecular mechanism is claimed. No blocking source gap remains after local XML/PDF/OA/supplement/database review.

paper_xml.coverage: peptide identities, MIC method, Tables 1-2, TLC-DB method/results/discussion, figure captions

paper_pdf.coverage: PDF text cross-check for methods, Tables 1-2, figure captions, TLC-DB discussion, and lack of mammalian toxicity table

oa_package.coverage: PMC package NXML/PDF plus Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 images checked for mechanism/phenotype support

supplementary_assets.coverage: No structured supplementary table exists locally; landed .bin files are HTML pages and do not change activity/mechanism/database decisions.

merged_database_rows.coverage: Database row reconciliation already source-reviewed; activity repair uses primary source tables rather than database-only rows.

supplementary_assets.note: Only HTML landing/ad page .bin files recovered; no source supplement table required for current gate.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Prior worker-4 database reconciliation remains accepted with cautions: source-verified MIC rows map to Tables 1-2, modified lipopeptide chemistry is preserved, and aggregate/database-only conflicts remain flagged.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 repair completed: the final/packet activity artifact now contains the complete recoverable primary-source MIC matrix from XML Tables 1-2 (72 rows) with units, target species/strain, assay conditions, and locators; no mammalian toxicity values are fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-5 repair completed: TLC-DB/resazurin and MIC data are classified as phenotype/screening evidence, resazurin free-thiol behavior is assay-interference context, and general membrane-disruption background is not promoted to direct mechanism.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_final_adjudication: Accepted with cautions because the owner-layer tickets are closed by source-reviewed repair and remaining limitations are nonblocking cautions rather than open rework targets.

semantic_quality_checks.evidence: 72 MIC rows from XML Tables 1-2; all rows have endpoint, raw value, unit, target species/strain, assay conditions, and source locator.
Mechanism claims use phenotype_supported, inferred_mechanism, or unknown_or_not_tested; direct_mechanism claim count is zero.
Landed .bin supplementary assets are HTML pages and no structured supplementary activity/mechanism table was recoverable locally.
rwk-complete-test-0001, rwk-codex-rereview-0002, and rwk-codex-rereview-0003 are closed by this source-reviewed owner-layer repair response.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Pal/Mir/Laur/TFA/dimer/NH2 chemistry is retained as reported by the primary source and not normalized to unmodified database core sequences.
Prior worker-4 reconciliation retained aggregate CAMP/dbAMP text rows and standalone CKK literature linkage as source_conflict/database-only cases.
Eight landed .bin assets were checked with file(1)/indexed text and are HTML pages, not recoverable scientific supplementary tables.
Figures and text support qualitative inhibition-zone screening but do not provide direct molecular mechanism or quantitative zone-size rows.
The paper warns that free-thiol cysteine peptides can reduce resazurin and vitiate TLC-DB interpretation; this is preserved as assay-interference context.
Local XML/PDF/OA materials do not report HC50/CC50 or mammalian cell toxicity values; no toxicity row is fabricated.

strict_gate.acceptance_boundary: Accepted with cautions only after worker-2/5 artifacts and worker-6 review pass strict semantic and publication-quality gates.
